objective: Bring 1 Qiraji Martial Drape, 2 Azure Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus.  You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.

description: I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, <name>.  I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, <class>.
I shall need a Qiraji drape, which I'll resize for you of course.  I'll also need idols and scarabs which I'll use to create a suitable clasp.
I promise you won't be disappointed.
progress: Did you bring the materials for the cloak, <name>?
completion: Ah yes... this drape is immaculate.
Take this cloak, <name>. May it protect you from the foul magic of the Qiraji.
